# The Jalopy Journal

> A community hub dedicated to preserving and celebrating traditional hot rods, custom cars, and authentic car culture worldwide.

The Jalopy Journal is the premier online resource for hot rod enthusiasts, custom car builders, and automotive historians. The site connects a global community of traditionalists who share a passion for classic vehicles, vintage automotive culture, and the stories behind iconic rides and legendary builders.

## Key Topics

- Hot Rods
- Custom Cars
- Traditional Kustoms
- Car Culture
- Automotive History
- Vintage Films
- Classic Vehicles
- Drag Racing
- Ford Roadster
- H.A.M.B.
- Ed Elliot
- Tom Cobbs
- Garage Journal
- Santa Ana Drags
- Pomona Fairplex
